articles.title: Tata Memorial Centre Launches Mobile Cancer Diagnostic Fleet for Rural Maharashtra
articles.description: State-of-the-art diagnostic buses equipped with digital mammography, pap smear screening, and telemedicine links deploy to underserved rural districts across Maharashtra.

articles.title: ICMR Clinical Guidelines Emphasize Routine HPV Screening for Cervical Cancer Prevention in India
articles.description: New national health directives recommend accessible HPV DNA testing and community screening camps for women aged 30–65 across primary healthcare centers.

articles.title: AIIMS New Delhi Breakthrough in Low-Cost CAR-T Cell Immunotherapy Clinical Trials
articles.description: Indigenous cellular therapy research demonstrates high efficacy in treating refractory blood cancers, significantly reducing treatment costs for Indian oncology patients.

articles.title: Avinya Care Expands Caregiver Navigation Services Across Bengaluru & Hyderabad
articles.description: Dedicated family counseling, respite assistance, and financial guidance help caregivers manage treatment journeys with dignity and resilience.

articles.title: Liquid Biopsy Blood Tests Enable Multi-Cancer Detection Before Symptoms Emerge
articles.description: Non-invasive genomic blood analysis measuring circulating tumor DNA opens new doors for early diagnosis in Indian healthcare centers.

articles.title: Nutritional Support and Ayurvedic Integrative Wellness Enhance Chemotherapy Resilience
articles.description: Evidence-based wellness guidelines combining clinical nutrition and gentle restorative care help patients maintain stamina during radiation and chemotherapy.
